==Description==
The '''Hallow Bones''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[Trick or Threat Town]] as part of the [[Halloween 2020 Event]]. It moved faster than the [[Bones (Trick or Threat Town)|Bones]] and slower than the [[Witch (Trick or Threat Town)|Witch]]. It had an average amount of health, for its debut.

The '''Hallow Bones''' could be spawned by the [[Reaper (Trick or Threat Town)|Reaper]] and [[Lord Sinister]].

==Appearance==
The '''Hallow Bones''' was structured similar to the [[Bones (Trick or Threat Town)|Bones]]. It was entirely made out of marble dark grey parts to represent a skeleton. It did not have a full torso, but instead had the bone cage for it. Its head was slightly smaller than usual and had two large yellow eyes. It had a slightly different walking animation.

==Strategy==
*Use [[Ranger]]s to quickly kill the '''Hallow Bones''' and do damage to the [[Reaper (Trick or Threat Town)|Reaper]] or [[Lord Sinister]] that can spawn the '''Hallow Bones'''.  
*Since '''Hallow Bones''' usually spawn in hordes, explosive towers, such as the [[Rocketeer]] and [[Mortar]], are useful when attempting to defeat this.
**However, note that the movement speed of the '''Hallow Bones''' might outrun the projectiles.
*Fast-firing towers, such as the [[Minigunner]] and the [[Turret]], are able to deal significant amounts of damage to the '''Hallow Bones'''.

==Trivia==
*The '''Hallow Bones''' had a death animation where it would fall into a pile of bones and its head would roll a short distance.
**This was also the same animation used for the [[Bones (Trick or Threat Town)|Bones]].
